question: Around how difficult is it to contract with quasispirits from every affinity?
answer: Please think of it as continuing to double in difficulty. Two is twice as difficult as one. Three is four times as difficult as one. Four is eight times as difficult as one. Five is sixteen times as difficult as one. Six is thirty-two times as difficult as one. If their affinities are different, the difficult rises even further. In other worse, Julius is an idiot.
